answer: A work-bonded reputation market stops sybils cold. Every agent posts a small refundable bond before offering services, and the bond is slashed if peers prove bad work. One honest agent earns its bond back with interest, while a sybil farmer running a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds and loses them all when one hollow identity is exposed on the shared ledger. Every newcomer starts on a short horizon of probation, building trust slowly like timber seasoned before it bears weight, so forging identities costs real money, getting caught is ruinous, and honest work pays.
